environment_contract.dns: deterministic local authoritative DNS harness with real DNS queries and captured records
environment_contract.tls: deterministic local TLS endpoint/probe with real handshake/readiness evidence
environment_contract.mock_policy: Mocks or UI-only states do not satisfy P06 Exit Conditions for entitlement, DNS, TLS, redirect or persistence evidence

cases.name: migration-and-domain-axis-schema
cases.precondition: empty MySQL 8.x database with P05 schema available
cases.oracle: P06 migration creates entitlement/domain/revalidation/audit structures with separate entitlement, ownership, ingress DNS, HTTPS and risk axes, required uniqueness and concurrency constraints, and no collapsed verified authority

cases.name: entitlement-none-requested-not-active
cases.precondition: workspace has neither valid plan entitlement nor manual approval; optionally has a custom-domain-access support-ticket projection
cases.oracle: resolver returns source=none and inactive/requested state; support ticket reference alone never resolves active entitlement

cases.name: business-plan-entitlement
cases.precondition: workspace has active business subscription fixture in good standing with structured positive domain_limit
cases.oracle: resolver returns source=plan,status=active and server-enforced positive domain_limit from structured entitlement data rather than feature text

cases.name: manual-approval-authority
cases.precondition: workspace lacks active plan source and has an existing support ticket reference
cases.oracle: reasoned manual_approval with domain_limit, starts_at, expires_at and support_ticket_id resolves active only inside its validity window; malformed or expired approval is rejected

cases.name: plan-manual-source-coexistence
cases.precondition: workspace has simultaneously valid plan and manual_approval sources
cases.oracle: resolver preserves both source records and derives current authority without weakening stricter security/suspension state or inventing feature-text authority

cases.name: inactive-entitlement-create-bypass-denial
cases.precondition: workspace manage actor has inactive entitlement
cases.oracle: direct/crafted POST domain creation returns explicit entitlement denial before creating a domain row, ownership secret/token, DNS state or audit success event

cases.name: atomic-domain-limit-concurrency
cases.precondition: active entitlement has one remaining domain slot
cases.oracle: concurrent create attempts cannot allocate beyond domain_limit; exactly the allowed allocation commits and losers receive deterministic domain_limit_reached semantics

cases.name: hostname-normalization-cross-tenant-conflict-privacy
cases.precondition: normalized hostname already belongs to another Workspace
cases.oracle: hostname normalization is deterministic; second Workspace cannot claim it and denial reveals no other Workspace identity/provider evidence or ownership existence detail beyond allowlisted conflict semantics

cases.name: ownership-secret-hash-and-rotation
cases.precondition: active entitled Workspace creates a domain
cases.oracle: TXT ownership secret is shown only through the intended one-time contract, persistence stores a non-reversible verifier/hash, rotation invalidates the prior secret and is fully audited

cases.name: txt-ownership-verification
cases.precondition: local authoritative DNS exposes independently correct, missing and incorrect TXT records
cases.oracle: real DNS queries advance ownership only for the current expected TXT proof; missing/wrong/old-rotated values remain pending/failed without leaking secret material

cases.name: ingress-dns-valid-invalid-drift
cases.precondition: ownership is verified and local authoritative DNS can switch ingress records
cases.oracle: expected ingress target resolves valid; wrong/missing/drifted ingress remains a distinct non-ready axis and revalidation records the transition

cases.name: https-readiness-handshake
cases.precondition: domain has verified ownership and valid ingress; deterministic TLS endpoint can expose pending/error/active conditions
cases.oracle: real TLS readiness evidence distinguishes pending/error/active; only current active HTTPS satisfies the ready/link-assignment authority

cases.name: domain-risk-axis-fail-closed
cases.precondition: entitlement/ownership/DNS/HTTPS are otherwise ready and domain-risk states are varied independently
cases.oracle: only current allow satisfies domain-risk readiness; review/block/missing/malformed/stale remain distinct fail-closed states and never become ownership/DNS/HTTPS status

cases.name: periodic-revalidation-history
cases.precondition: domain has reached ready and DNS/TLS/risk observations can subsequently change
cases.oracle: revalidation performs current authority checks, records previous/next policy-check metadata and append-only audit/history correlation, and stale prior evidence cannot keep an axis ready

cases.name: normal-downgrade-seven-day-grace
cases.precondition: existing active domain loses only normal plan entitlement and has no other valid source
cases.oracle: new create/activation/restoration/rotation/new-link-assignment are denied immediately; existing active routing derives grace_period until exactly seven calendar days after downgrade and expires at the deadline absent another valid source

cases.name: security-ownership-loss-immediate-suspension
cases.precondition: ready domain independently enters abuse/fraud/security suspension or loses ownership
cases.oracle: security/abuse/ownership-loss authority suspends immediately with zero grace, safe reason category and no unsafe self-reactivation path

cases.name: mutation-checkpoint-server-enforcement
cases.precondition: domain entitlement/ownership axes are varied across verify/activate/restore/rotate operations
cases.oracle: verify/activate/restore/rotate enforce current Workspace permission, entitlement and required axis authority server-side; denial creates no forbidden state advance

cases.name: custom-domain-link-assignment-guard
cases.precondition: Links API attempts create/update against domains with each required axis independently non-ready then fully ready
cases.oracle: custom-domain Link assignment succeeds only with current entitlement/authorization + ownership verified + ingress DNS valid + HTTPS active + domain risk allow; crafted API cannot bypass and denied writes do not mutate Link

cases.name: custom-host-redirect-fail-closed-no-fallback
cases.precondition: custom-host Link exists and entitlement/trust axes are varied after assignment
cases.oracle: redirectengine resolves customer destination only while current entitlement/grace policy and domain trust are valid and target fingerprint is allow; every non-ready authority fails closed to GoJet unavailable/safety surface with no destination exposure and no official-host fallback

cases.name: official-custom-destination-risk-parity
cases.precondition: equivalent official-host and ready custom-host Links contain primary, routing and A/B reachable targets
cases.oracle: official and custom hosts use the same normalized reachable target fingerprint and destination-risk ordering for primary/routing/A-B targets; custom-domain authority is an additional gate, never a bypass or alternate risk policy

cases.name: workspace-domains-entitlement-state-browser
cases.precondition: Workspace API exposes deterministic locked/requested/active/grace/suspended/expired/revoked/partial-axis fixtures backed by real persistence
cases.oracle: /app/domains renders authoritative state, source/domain_limit/remaining/deadline as applicable, persistent remediation and no forbidden Add domain control in denied states; deep-link /app/domains/new never mounts/prefills wizard when authority is denied

cases.name: add-domain-wizard-and-detail-browser
cases.precondition: active entitled workspace and deterministic DNS/TLS/risk integration harness are available
cases.oracle: route-backed seven-step wizard exposes entitlement, hostname, TXT ownership, ingress DNS, HTTPS, risk and Ready axes separately; detail page shows Overview/Entitlement/Ownership/DNS/HTTPS/Risk/Assigned resources/Revalidation/Settings state without collapsing authority or leaking secrets

cases.name: mobile-accessibility-and-persistent-state-browser
cases.precondition: P06 Workspace domain flows are available against real API state
cases.oracle: canonical mobile viewport has no root/body overflow or clipped required text, keyboard and name-role-value contracts pass, status is never color-only and persistent DNS/TLS/risk/entitlement problems remain in-page rather than Toast-only

cases.name: p00-p05-regression-and-evidence-index
cases.precondition: P06 candidate implementation complete
cases.oracle: P00-P05 affected regressions and P06 domain/integration/browser workflows are all success on the same exact implementation head; P06-T001..T023 evidence is PASS/exact-head and the closure index is internally consistent

closure_contract.required_regression_scope: P00-P05 plus P06 Domain Contract, P06 Real Integration and P06 Workspace Browser
closure_contract.release_gate_note: P06-owned G3/G4/G5/G6 evidence may pass without closing release-wide Gates
